sents.text: Nineteen ninety three. You ran home from school, dropped your backpack, and turned on the TV.
Five teenagers with attitude. Red, blue, black, yellow, and pink.
Then came the words every kid shouted. It's morphin time!
They flipped and kicked through an army of putties.
Just when they won, the monster grew as tall as a skyscraper.
So the zords combined into the Megazord, and one sword slash ended it.
Then the Green Ranger showed up, and became everyone's favorite.
At recess, everybody argued over who got to be the red one.
Which ranger were you? Comment your color, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse for more memory lane.
